$comment: Known public exposures of this repository, tracked until they are fully remediated.
This file intentionally contains NO credential values -- only commit ids, paths and
shape names. scripts/check-exposure.mjs inspects retrieved content in memory and
reports the matched rule name, never the matched text.
An entry must NOT be deleted or marked resolved until BOTH are true:
1. the credential owner has rotated/revoked the value, and
2. the platform no longer serves the pre-purge objects.
Deleting an entry is an assertion that remediation is complete. Assert it only when it is.
Timeline: the credential was committed 2026-10-03 and the repository is public, so
assume it was harvested. Rotation is urgent regardless of what this monitor reports.

exposures.ownerAction: decolua (9router) must restrict or rotate the Firebase key in Google Cloud, by API and HTTP referrer.
exposures.notes: Inherited from upstream 9router, which hardcoded it. Alert #1 stays open until rotation is confirmed.

exposures.ownerAction: decolua (9router) must rotate the iFlow OAuth client secret. No GitHub alert was raised for this one.
exposures.notes: Higher risk than the Firebase key: an OAuth client secret plus the public client id allows impersonation of the OAuth client. Carries no distinguishing prefix, so shape-based rules could not name it.
